The `member.joined` event is emitted from `invitation-service.ts`. `organization-service.ts` emits it too, when an organization is created. Two files register handlers for it:

- **`src/server/services/usage-service.ts`** subscribes at line 89. It imports `organization-repository` and `usage-repository`.
- **`src/server/services/notification-service.ts`** subscribes at line 231. The registry loads it through a bare `import "./notification-service"`. It imports `issue-repository`, `notification-repository`, `organization-repository` and `notification-preference-repository`.

`activity-service.ts` and `webhook-service.ts` don't subscribe to `member.joined`. `event-registry.ts` only wires the listener groups, so it isn't a handler file for this event either.

The union of repository files imported by those two files is:

ANSWER: src/server/repositories/organization-repository.ts, src/server/repositories/usage-repository.ts, src/server/repositories/issue-repository.ts, src/server/repositories/notification-repository.ts, src/server/repositories/notification-preference-repository.ts
